description: List the PM schedules linked to a compliance item, or the compliance items a PM schedule counts toward. Pass compliance_item_id or pm_schedule_id (one is required). Each link carries required_frequency_days (how often the schedule must be completed for the item to stay compliant) and weight.

compliance_item_id.description: Compliance item ID - resolve via list_compliance_items

pm_schedule_id.description: PM schedule ID - resolve via list_pm_schedules

name: list_compliance_pm_schedules
title: List compliance PM schedules
